bio_en: Armen Topjian was born in Chmshkatsag in 1890; after the massacres of 1895 his family moved to Aleppo, where he graduated from the Nersisian (Haykazian) school in 1905 and studied two more years at the Sultaniye school. The Topjian brothers were respected craftsmen who held municipal contracts in Aleppo. After the 1909 Adana massacre he was ordered to move fifteen bombs hidden in the family shop; arrested in December 1909 and threatened with death, he refused to talk and was released after two years thanks to ARF-Ittihad cooperation and friends in the court. He died on 18 December 1962.
